hypothesis: Monotonic checkpoints reduce completed-step rework after identical induced failures relative to all-or-nothing replay.
accept_when: granularity_1 mean_reworked_steps < all_or_nothing mean_reworked_steps and reduction_fraction >= 0.50
refute_when: granularity_1 mean_reworked_steps >= all_or_nothing mean_reworked_steps or reduction_fraction < 0.50
